decisionBoundary: SCIENCE_COMPLETE means the repository contains the currently mapped Class 6 Curiosity Chapters 1-12 with Kiki-teachable instruction, independently authored examples/content, linked assessments, remediation/mastery evidence, deterministic chapter QA, separate synthetic school-learning-needs validation, local-first/offline integration evidence, rights/source boundaries and child-safety/privacy controls. It is not a live-school efficacy claim, attainment claim, accreditation, accessibility certification, medical/safety certification or proof of school-specific pacing.
rightsBoundary: Curriculum/book chapter structure is mapping metadata. KirthiVerse teaching text, examples, questions, hints, explanations and remediation are independently authored; the completion decision does not authorise reproduction of textbook prose, figures or exercises.
schoolBoundary: SAN Academy Tambaram is a validation-context overlay. This audit does not claim school attestation, live student evidence, efficacy, attainment or school-specific pacing.
accessibilityBoundary: The audit verifies repository accessibility contracts and existing deterministic/release checks where encoded. It is not a human WCAG conformance certification or assistive-technology lab certification.
governanceRule: Any future change to mapped Science curriculum structure, learner runtime, assessment contracts, privacy/safety controls, rights/source policy, offline integration or completion criteria must preserve or explicitly supersede this audit through reviewed repository evidence and regression testing.
